mapper.insert: insert into ai_task_log(admin_id, task_type, input_json, output_json, status) values(#{adminId}, #{taskType}, #{inputJson}, #{outputJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: select * from ai_task_log where (admin_id = #{adminId} or #{adminId} is null) order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_task_log set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
